first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The purple lightning-patterned sniper rifle supported by the gun-holding hand in the lower-right foreground, with a long black barrel and a large scope.

entities.name: gun-holding hand
entities.identification: The partially visible hand and forearm below Weapon A, wearing a fluorescent-green and gray-white paneled glove.

entities.name: group of white cargo crates covered with teal tarps
entities.identification: The collection of cargo crates on the stone-paved area, with white compartmentalized crate walls and teal top covers.

entities.name: stone-paved area
entities.identification: The irregular light-brown stone-paved ground on the cargo-crate side of the low wall, with a red spray-painted line in part of the area.

entities.name: group of fallen people
entities.identification: Two horizontally lying people in dark clothing, one in the nearby road and the other beside the curb on the near side of Vehicle A.

entities.name: outer road
entities.identification: The dark-gray road outside the low wall leading into the distance between the buildings, with a light-colored edge line and a red-and-white curb.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The faded light-green boxy sedan beside the curb on the left, with its front facing the near end of the road.

entities.name: low light-colored concrete wall
entities.identification: The off-white low wall with a wide, thick, straight top edge between the stone-paved area and the outer road.

entities.name: star-marked wooden crate at the foot of the wall
entities.identification: The gray-brown crate at the foot of the wall on one side of the road, with a dark star-shaped marking on the upper panel facing the camera.

entities.name: group of pale yellow-white flat-roofed buildings
entities.identification: The collection of off-white and pale-yellow stucco buildings along the street, with windows, faded wall signs, awnings, and partially openwork parapets.

entities.name: pale-blue sky
entities.identification: The bright light-blue sky area above the building roofs.

entities.name: group of overhead power lines
entities.identification: Multiple thin, dark overhead lines above the buildings, roughly parallel and forming slightly sagging arcs.

entities.name: group of curved-top streetlights
entities.identification: The collection of street fixtures composed of thin dark poles, curved lamp arms, and light-colored lamp heads.

entities.name: green vegetation in the neighborhood
entities.identification: Sparse green branches and leaves behind the wall on the left, as well as sparse patches of grass beside the wall around the area.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: The long gun lying diagonally beside the curb near the low wall on the outer road, with a thin dark section and a thicker brown section.

entities.name: dark small bag-like object at the foot of the wall
entities.identification: The compact, dark, irregular small object on the road side of the low wall, to the right of Weapon D.
